text: Fresh complete two-file79-line patch read. Row construction passes compact-mode information as semantic excludeSubfolders rather than teaching the row the UI mode name. _setURI consults saved collapse state before setFolder computes message indicators and counts; bypassing that restoration makes the row use direct-folder rather than recursive counts. Removing the last child also expands an empty parent row. This concerns a named compact/favorite transition and last-child lifecycle, not a rule that all rows must always be expanded. Fixed row still sets collapsed state before getNumUnread/getTotalMessages with the collapsed Boolean. The current caller additionally requires that the selected mode canBeCompact; that later guard is not attributed to this landing. No tests change. A source-based test proposal covers the described compact toggle and last-favorite-child removal while asserting direct-folder counts and row state. Later regression metadata is a locator only; no later fix, folder UI, native accessibility or automated test was exercised.
title: Set row collapse semantics before computing direct or recursive folder counts
